description: Ship module MMG manoeuvring model: KVLCC2 L7 (Yasukawa & Yoshimura 2015) as a box in NHFLOW with surge, sway and yaw free; MMG hull derivatives, added mass solved implicitly by the coupling (body frame -> inertial), MMG propeller wake, rudder with f_alpha and asymmetric gamma_R, fluid loads in surge/sway/yaw masked (mmg_fluid 0), 10/10 zig-zag start, 2 MPI ranks.
